description: This source file defines the MetricsReporterConfig interface, which provides configuration methods for metrics reporting in a health checking utility. It includes method signatures for retrieving resolution duration and history count, and defines an enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: MetricsReporterConfig

methods.description: Returns the duration resolution for measurement intervals.
